organizationAi.title: AI Features
organizationAi.enableTitle: Enable AI powered features for your organization
organizationAi.cloudDescription: This setting applies to all users and projects. Any data <emphasis>can</emphasis> be sent to AWS Bedrock within the Langfuse data region. Your data will not be used for training models. Applicable HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR, and ISO 27001 compliance remains intact. <docs>More details in the docs here.</docs>
organizationAi.selfHostedDescription: This setting applies to all users and projects. When enabled, the assistant can send relevant project data to the model provider configured by your instance administrator.
organizationAi.telemetryTitle: AI Data Use for Product/Service Improvement
organizationAi.telemetryDescription: Share data about your use of AI with Langfuse for product and service improvement.
organizationAi.confirmDescription: You are about to {action} AI features for your organization. When enabled, relevant data can be sent {destination} for processing.
organizationAi.cloudDestination: to AWS Bedrock in your data region
organizationAi.selfHostedDestination: to the model provider configured by your instance administrator
organizationAi.confirmQuestion: Are you sure you want to proceed?

featurePreviews.title: Feature Preview
featurePreviews.subtitle: Try upcoming and experimental product experiences before they become generally available.

modernSession.description: Navigate every trace in a session from one continuous conversation feed, with tools and structured data available on demand.
modernSession.details: Compact Session View replaces separate trace cards with a compact minimap and a virtualized feed. Jump between traces, keep the active trace in view, or temporarily show inline tool calls and system prompts.
modernSession.alt: Compact Session View showing a trace minimap beside a continuous session conversation feed.

featurePreviews.eventsRequired: Compact Session View is only available on the events-backed session view. Turn on {preview} to enable it.
featurePreviews.environmentEnabled: This preview is enabled by LANGFUSE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES, so a per-user opt-out does not disable it.

verifiedDomains.title: Verified Domains
verifiedDomains.description: You can only configure SSO for domains your organization owns. Verify a domain via DNS to enable SSO for it.
verifiedDomains.notAvailableDescription: Verified Domains and Enterprise SSO are not available on your plan. Please upgrade to access this feature.
verifiedDomains.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to manage verified domains for this organization.
verifiedDomains.dnsInstruction: Add the following TXT record to your DNS provider:
verifiedDomains.dnsPropagation: DNS changes may take up to 24 hours to propagate. After adding the record, click Verify.
verifiedDomains.validDomain: Must be a valid domain (e.g. acme.com)
verifiedDomains.addedDescription: Add the DNS TXT record shown in the table, then click Verify.
verifiedDomains.verifiedRemoveDescription: If an SSO configuration exists for this domain, you must remove it first. The domain can be re-verified later.
verifiedDomains.pendingRemoveDescription: This removes the pending claim. The domain can be re-added and verified later.

sso.title: SSO Configuration
sso.description: Configure Single Sign-On per verified domain. Once active, every user signing in with that domain is redirected to your identity provider.
sso.notAvailableDescription: Enterprise SSO is not available on your plan. Please upgrade to access this feature.
sso.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to configure SSO for this organization.
sso.verifyFirst: Verify a domain in the section above to configure SSO for it.
sso.idTokenDescription: Leave off for identity providers that release email only via the userinfo endpoint.
sso.activationWarning: Saving will activate SSO for @{domain} within 1 hour. Every user at that domain will be redirected to your identity provider on sign-in. They will not be able to use Google, GitHub, password, or any other method until SSO is deleted.
sso.replaceWarning: The new credentials will replace the active configuration.
sso.testTip: Tip: sign in via the new SSO in a second browser to confirm it works before closing this tab.
sso.callbackDescription: Add this URL as an authorized redirect URI in your identity provider.
sso.removeDescription: Users at this domain will be able to sign in with any enabled method again. Active sessions are not invalidated.

actions.deleteDescription: This action permanently deletes this model definition.

upsert.discard: Discard your unsaved changes to this model definition?
upsert.createDescription: Create a new model configuration to track generation costs.
upsert.nameDescription: The name of the model. This will be used to reference the model in the API. You can track price changes of models by using the same name and match pattern.
upsert.patternDescription: Regular expression (Postgres syntax) to match ingested generations (model attribute) to this model definition. For an exact, case-insensitive match to a model name, use the expression: (?i)^(modelname)$
upsert.tokenizerDescription: Optionally, Langfuse can tokenize the input and output of a generation if no unit counts are ingested. This is useful for streamed OpenAI completions, for example. See the <docs>documentation</docs> for supported tokenizers.
upsert.tokenizerConfigDescription: The tokenizer configuration. It is required for openai. See the <docs>documentation</docs> for details.
upsert.updatedDescription: The model “{modelName}” has been successfully updated. New generations will use these model prices.
upsert.createdDescription: The model “{modelName}” has been successfully created. New generations will use these model prices.

pricingEditor.description: Set prices per usage type for this model. Usage types must exactly match the keys of the ingested usage details.
pricingEditor.tiersDescription: Define pricing rules evaluated in priority order. Tiers are checked from top to bottom until conditions match.
pricingEditor.priceCount: {count, plural, one {# price set} other {# prices set}}

conditions.warning: Warning: Non-default tiers require at least one condition. This tier will fail validation.
conditions.usageDescription: Match and sum usage keys such as input or cached tokens.
conditions.keyDescription: Match this key exactly; nested paths are not supported.
conditions.exactValuesDescription: Comma-separated exact values. All other tier conditions still apply.

testMatch.title: Test Model Match
testMatch.description: Test which model and pricing tier your ingestion data would match against.
testMatch.modelNameDescription: The model name on your generations.
testMatch.modelParametersDescription: Add top-level model parameters used by pricing tier conditions.
testMatch.metadataDescription: Add top-level metadata used by pricing tier conditions.
testMatch.usageDetailsDescription: Add usage details to test pricing tier matching. Leave empty to match the default tier.
testMatch.noMatchDescription: No model configuration matches “{modelName}” in this project.
testMatch.viewPatterns: View existing models and their match patterns

detail.tierConditionsDescription: This tier is applied when the following conditions are met:

table.nameDescription: Standardized model name. Generations are assigned to this model name if they match the `matchPattern` upon ingestion.
table.patternDescription: Regex pattern to match the `model` parameter of generations to model pricing.
table.tokenizerDescription: Tokenizer used for this model to calculate token counts if none are ingested. Pick from the list of supported tokenizers.
table.configDescription: Some tokenizers require additional configuration (for example, openai tiktoken). See the documentation for details.
table.maintainerDescription: Maintainer of the model. Langfuse-managed models can be cloned; user-managed models can be edited and deleted. To supersede a Langfuse-managed model, set the custom model name to the Langfuse model name.
table.lastUsedDescription: Start time of the latest generation using this model.

paymentBanner.title: Billing Issue:
paymentBanner.description: We have problems collecting subscription payment for your organization “{organizationName}”. Please update your payment information to continue using Langfuse.

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.projectDescription: Track who changed what in your project and when. Monitor settings, configurations, and data changes over time. Reach out to the Langfuse team if you require more detailed or filtered audit logs.
auditLogs.organizationDescription: Track who changed what in your organization and when. Monitor organization settings, project creation/deletion, and membership changes over time.
auditLogs.projectUpgrade: Audit logs are an Enterprise feature. Upgrade your plan to track all changes made to your project.
auditLogs.organizationUpgrade: Audit logs are an Enterprise feature. Upgrade your plan to track all changes made to your organization.
auditLogs.projectAccess: Contact your project administrator to request access.
auditLogs.organizationAccess: Contact your organization administrator to request access.
auditLogs.actorDescription: The actor within Langfuse who performed the action.

connection.loadFailure: Failed to load Slack integration status. Please try again.
connection.connectDescription: Connect your Slack workspace to send notifications
connection.connectDetail: Connect your Slack workspace to enable real-time notifications for your automations.

connect.installUnavailable: Install URL not available. Please try again.
connect.popupBlocked: Popup blocked. Please allow popups and try again.

disconnect.successDescription: Successfully disconnected from your Slack workspace.
disconnect.confirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect your Slack workspace from this project?
disconnect.removeBot: Remove the bot from your Slack workspace
disconnect.reconnect: You can reconnect at any time, but you'll need to reconfigure your automations.

testMessage.successDescription: Test message sent successfully to the selected channel.

channels.loading: Loading Slack channels. This can take a while for large workspaces.
channels.loadFailed: Failed to load channels. You can still enter a channel name manually, or check your Slack connection and try again.
channels.privateUnavailable: Private channels are not visible. To access private channels, <reauthenticate>re-authenticate your Slack integration</reauthenticate> to grant the required permissions.

blobActions.validateTooltip: Test your saved configuration by uploading a small test file to your storage
blobActions.runNowTooltip: Trigger an immediate export of all data since the last sync
blobActions.runNowConfirm: Are you sure you want to run the blob storage export now? This will export all data since the last sync.
blobActions.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset the Blob Storage integration for this project?

integrationsOverview.title: Integrations
integrationsOverview.posthogDescription: We have teamed up with PostHog (OSS product analytics) to make Langfuse Events/Metrics available in your PostHog dashboards.
integrationsOverview.mixpanelDescription: Integrate with Mixpanel to sync your Langfuse traces, generations, and scores for advanced product analytics and insights.
integrationsOverview.blobStorageDescription: Configure scheduled exports of your trace data to S3-compatible storage or Azure Blob Storage. Set up a scheduled export to your own storage for data analysis or backup purposes.
integrationsOverview.slackDescription: Connect a Slack workspace and create channel automations to receive Langfuse alerts natively in Slack.

settings.title: Usage & Billing
settings.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to view the billing settings of this organization.

plan.invalidPaymentMethod: You do not have a valid payment method. Please update your billing details.
plan.cancelledNotice: Your organization cancelled the subscription. Features of the {plan} plan will be available until {date}.
plan.scheduledSwitchNotice: Your organization is scheduled to switch from {currentPlan} to {newPlan} on {date}.

usage.currentPeriod: Consumed {usageType} in current billing period (updated about once every 60 minutes)

discount.title: Discounts:
discount.description: Enter a valid promotion code to apply it to your subscription.

planDescriptions.core: Great to get started for most projects with unlimited users and 90 days data access.
planDescriptions.pro: For projects that scale and need unlimited data access, high rate limits, and Slack support.
planDescriptions.team: Organizational and security controls for larger teams.
planDescriptions.enterprise: For large scale teams. Enterprise-grade support and security.

changePlan.legacyStart: We will end your current subscription now and start a new one immediately.
changePlan.legacyInvoice: You will receive an invoice today that includes (1) the base fee for the new plan for a fresh billing period starting today and (2) your base fee and usage to date on the previous subscription.
changePlan.legacyConfirm: By confirming, you accept the immediate invoice and plan activation starting now.
changePlan.upgradeCharge: You will be charged a prorated base fee today for the remainder of this billing period. Features update immediately; usage-based charges continue for the rest of the billing period.
changePlan.upgradeExample: Example: if your plan is $199/month and you upgrade halfway through the month to a $499/month plan, the prorated charge is roughly $99.5 + $249.5 (plus taxes). Exact amounts depend on timing and tax.
changePlan.upgradeConfirm: By confirming, you accept the prorated charge and immediate plan change.
changePlan.downgradeCharge: No charge is made today. You stay on your current plan until the end of this billing period, then we switch you to the new plan. You can switch back anytime.
changePlan.downgradeConfirm: Usage continues to be billed under your current plan until the switch. By confirming, you schedule the change at period end and understand features will adjust at that time.

keepPlan.title: Confirm Keeping Current Plan
keepPlan.description: You have a scheduled plan change on your current subscription. Keeping your current plan will remove that schedule and you will remain on your existing plan.
keepPlan.confirmation: Your features and pricing will stay as-is; usage continues to be billed under your current plan. Do you want to keep your current plan and cancel the scheduled change?

cancellation.scheduled: Subscription will be cancelled at period end
cancellation.reactivateDescription: Reactivating removes the scheduled cancellation. Your subscription will continue beyond the current billing period and renew until you cancel again.
cancellation.reactivateConfirmation: Your features and usage billing remain unchanged. By confirming, you agree to future renewals and charges.
cancellation.cancelDescription: Your subscription will not renew. You will retain access until the end of the current billing period.
cancellation.cancelConfirmation: Usage during the remainder of the period is still billed under your current plan. By confirming, you schedule the cancellation for period end. You can reactivate before that date if you change your mind.

support.title: Access Restricted
support.description: Contact your system or project administrator for access, or upgrade your plan. Need help? Reach out to support.

spendAlerts.title: Spend Alerts
spendAlerts.description: Get notified when your organization's spending exceeds configured thresholds. Alerts may be delayed by up to 90 minutes.
spendAlerts.dialogDescription: Get notified when your organization's spending exceeds a limit.
spendAlerts.calculation: The limit is evaluated against your upcoming invoice total, including base fee, running usage fees, discounts, and taxes.
spendAlerts.oncePerCycle: Alerts trigger once per billing cycle.
spendAlerts.emailNotification: You will receive an email when the alert is triggered.
spendAlerts.evaluationDelay: Alerts are evaluated with a 90 minute delay.
spendAlerts.saveFailed: Failed to {action} spend alert. Please try again.
spendAlerts.titleTooLong: Title must be less than 100 characters
spendAlerts.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this spend alert? This action cannot be undone and you will no longer receive notifications for this threshold.
spendAlerts.deleteFailed: Failed to delete spend alert. Please try again.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: Data retention automatically deletes events older than the specified number of days. The value must be 0 or at least 3 days. Set to 0 to retain data indefinitely. Deletion happens asynchronously, so events may remain available for a while after they expire.
retention.change: Your Project's retention will be set from {current} to {next} days.
retention.current: Your Project's current retention is {days} days.
